notebook.title: Notebooks
notebook.subtitle: Capture your ideas. Open any notebook to write full screen.
notebook.pagedDescription: Write page by page for classes and study notes
notebook.boardDescription: Think freely, beyond the edges of a page
notebook.searchPlaceholder: Search by notebook name or folder
notebook.emptyHint: Choose a paged notebook or a free canvas to write full screen. Your existing text notes appear here too.
notebook.noResultsHint: Try another keyword or clear the type filter.
notebook.loadFailed: Could not load the complete notebook library
notebook.incompleteHint: This list may be incomplete. Retry to continue; a loading error does not mean there are no notebooks.
notebook.paginationStalled: Resource pagination did not advance. Please refresh and retry.
notebook.saveBeforeCloseFailed: This note is not safely saved yet. Keep it open, resolve the save error, then try returning again.
notebook.storageHint: Uses your existing notes and files in the resource library. Nothing is moved or duplicated.

workspace.documentMismatch: The loaded notebook does not match the current file. Please retry.
workspace.unsupportedSchema: This handwritten notebook version ({{version}}) is not supported. Update the app and retry.
workspace.exitBlocked: Saving is not complete. Your editor and draft are preserved. Retry saving before returning or switching notebooks.

status.conflict: A newer version exists. Your draft is kept.
status.offline: Could not save. A local recovery draft is saved.
status.storage-error: Local recovery storage failed. This stroke is not saved safely; keep this page open and retry or copy your work.

board.summaryUnavailable: Could not verify the board z-order summary. Nothing new was saved; keep the board open and retry.
board.askAiUnavailable: AI board crop is not connected yet.
board.exportUnavailable: Board export is not connected yet.
board.exportInvalidGrid: Page size must be finite and positive.
board.exportRegionUnavailable: No finite board region is available to export.
board.navigationDesktop: Drag with Space to pan, wheel to zoom, or draw with the pen.
board.navigationTouch: One finger draws when touch drawing is on; two fingers pan and zoom.

errors.backgroundLoadFailed: Could not load the page background.
errors.operationFailed: Could not complete the editor action.
errors.selectionTooLarge: Selection exceeds the current page. Paste on the free canvas instead.
